sources.name: RapidJSON
sources.notes: Only include/ and license.txt are distributed in the source bundle. bin/jsonchecker and thirdparty/gtest are excluded. license.txt also documents components not included in these binaries.

sources.name: Eigen
sources.licenseName: Mixed upstream file licenses; see COPYING.README and COPYING.*
sources.notes: MPL-2.0 is the primary upstream license. The complete source tree also includes BSD, LGPL, GPL, Apache and MINPACK material. This inventory makes no blanket per-file license conclusion.

sources.name: Zstandard
sources.notes: Source bundle includes library sources and CMake build files; unused CLI/test trees are excluded.
